items.title: Jacobs Solutions (J) Lands Utah Canal Modernization Project
items.summary: Jacobs Solutions (NYSE:J) won a major engineering contract to modernize the Strawberry High Line Canal in Utah into a pressurized water system. The project focuses on upgrading century old infrastructure that supports regional water conveyance, agriculture, and urban growth. Jacobs will work with local agencies to redesign and deliver the modernization of this critical canal system.
